metadata.title: File Sharing and Sync

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for controlled sharing, synchronization, and collaborative access to digital content.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud file storage, file synchronization services, and collaborative document platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governed file sharing and synchronization with explicit access scope, lifecycle control, and auditability.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Shared files, folders, permissions, access tokens, version history, synchronization state, and sharing audit metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: File Sharing and Sync inherit baseline collaboration trust, identity context, and lifecycle governance from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: File sharing frequently involves unmanaged endpoints and off‑network access, requiring controls aligned with SP 800-46.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External file sharing and collaboration across organizational boundaries must align with SP 800-47 trust‑boundary guidance.

metadata.remarks: File Sharing and Sync defines the collaboration modality through which digital content is exchanged, synchronized, and co‑authored. This capability presents elevated risk due to persistent access, external sharing, and automated synchronization. The pattern governs access scope, sharing semantics, lifecycle control, and auditability while inheriting collaboration trust invariants from Collaboration Core.

components.title: Access Scope and Sharing Control
components.description: Constrains who may access shared content and how sharing permissions are granted, delegated, and revoked.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships through overly permissive or unintended file sharing.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts or sharing links to gain unauthorized access to shared content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit access control and scoped sharing permissions limit unauthorized content access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to shared content is explicitly managed and reviewed.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict unauthorized content access.

components.title: Data Exposure and Exfiltration Prevention
components.description: Protects shared content from unauthorized disclosure through misuse of sharing or synchronization mechanisms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of sensitive data via web services and cloud storage sharing.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of established collaboration channels for data exfiltration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Content inspection, classification, and sharing policy enforcement reduce exfiltration risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection and policy enforcement govern content movement.
Monitoring detects anomalous content access and sharing behavior.

components.title: Lifecycle Management and Persistence Control
components.description: Manages creation, versioning, retention, and retirement of shared content to reduce residual risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized persistence and collection of information through long‑lived shared repositories.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance reduces exposure from abandoned or unmanaged shared content.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unnecessary or unmanaged sharing functionality is reduced.
Policies define lifecycle expectations for shared content.

components.title: Auditability and Traceability
components.description: Provides visibility into access, sharing, modification, and synchronization events for accountability and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of audit evidence related to shared content misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Comprehensive logging and version history support accountability and forensic analysis.

implemented-requirements.remarks: File access, sharing, and modification events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection and investigation of inappropriate access or sharing.
